I asked the investigator whether an order with SPRING15 would fail the same way, and it says yes. Any order carrying a code that isn't in the table (WELCOME10 and VIP20 only) reaches the unguarded lookup at `OrderTotal.cs` line 18 and throws `KeyNotFoundException`. The investigator rated this high confidence, with the cause and area unchanged (code). It could not say which orders carry SPRING15, because it did not read any order records.

I decided again and the decision is still auto-fix, under the Decisions row for a certain crash in this method's code from a retired discount code. The fix has to give no discount for any unknown code, so the totals for WELCOME10, VIP20 and no-code orders stay the same. As before, I can't brief the coder directly, since it isn't on my list of agents I may ask. The decision is recorded for it.
